notes.title: 「逐鹿 EA」update announcement 1.7.0
notes.notes:
1."Self-created military generals" is officially launched

2.The transportation function provides two modes: "designated route" or "selected destination"

3.Use the ESC key to return to the desktop

4.Added the ability to scale freely in windowed mode

5.Optimize the distribution strategy of the remaining generals when the force is destroyed

notes.title: 「逐鹿」EA update announcement 1.6.24
notes.notes:
Hi, players

The「逐鹿」EA ushered in a new update (1.6.24). In addition to adding female generals and new images in the recommendation, this update focused on adjusting the generals and generals' skills. 

The main content of this update is as follows:

1. Recommended to increase female generals

This update has added female generals and new images to the recommendation, which are divided into female generals (wu, tong) and Huizhi (intellect, politics);
tips: Use female generals to recommend, the probability of new female generals will be higher.

未来我们还将加入更多的女武将形象，让我们一起期待新形象的到来吧~

4.generals skill group adjustment

tips: After the skill is changed, in the old archive, the new skill level is the initial state

5. General adjustment

6. open forces

8. The morale of the troops will be recalculated when the troops are replenished;

The above is the whole content of this update. In the future, we will continue to work hard, continue to develop and optimize more content, and make 「逐鹿」 more perfect. We also welcome your valuable suggestions, so that we can do better together .

notes.title: 「逐鹿」EA update announcement 1.6.23
notes.notes:
Hi, players

「逐鹿」EA ushered in a new update (1.6.23). This update will usher in a major feature and several updates. Let's see the content of this update~

The main content of this update is as follows:

1. The function "recommendation" is added, and random generals can be obtained through recommendation, which can be recommended once a year;
Along with the emergence of new generals, there are new characteristics, general skills and training;
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42499535/7ebf47f6e904857c426d6c5fade56017700e5496.png

The higher the intelligence, the shorter the time required to choose the recommended general;
https://media.st.dl.eccdnx.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42499535/2712b6b1a5cb97e27a94383fe863682b04c1e0fd.png

The recommended generals are divided into: Maocai (wisdom), Wumeng (wu), Yongwu (common), Xiaolian (government)
https://media.st.dl.eccdnx.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42499535/e0ca0b6d5cc23c7ca347ca39782a2745fe16ca2d.png
